text: 金十数据9月23日讯，9月23日，中铝集团与中国电子在北京签署战略合作协议。根据协议，双方将在人工智能与高质量数据集、自主安全软硬件、工业控制系统、数字化基础设施、网络安全等方面深化合作。
text_en: Jinshi Data, September 23 - On September 23, Chinalco Group and China Electronics signed a strategic cooperation agreement in Beijing. According to the agreement, the two sides will deepen cooperation in areas such as artificial intelligence and high-quality datasets, independently secure software and hardware, industrial control systems, digital infrastructure, and cybersecurity.
